The '''''Snow Goose''''' is a riverboat.

==Activities==
The ''Snow Goose'' carried [[Moiraine Damodred]], [[Lan Mandragoran]], [[Perrin Aybara]], [[Loial]], and [[Faile Bashere]] from [[Remen]], in [[Altara]], to the city of [[Illian]].{{ref/book|3|35}}{{ref/book|3|41}}
